title: Tri-State Ohio-Wabash Confluence Community AOI
description: Community-scale acquisition and simulation envelope for the Lower Wabash and Ohio River confluence. Operational AOI is derived from authoritative hydrography, watershed boundaries and river reaches rather than a private residence.
source: USGS NHDPlus HR + USGS WBD + USGS 3DEP + FEMA NFHL + USACE NLD; see data/registries/tsm-tri-state-data-fabric-v2.json
